paly.definition:
a. Pale; wanting color; dim.
a. Divided into four or more equal parts by perpendicular lines,
   and of two different tinctures disposed alternately.

palyer.definition:
comparative of paly
a. Pale; wanting color; dim.
a. Divided into four or more equal parts by perpendicular lines,
   and of two different tinctures disposed alternately.
palyer.translation: (paly 的比较级) a. 略显苍白的

palying.definition:
-ing form of paly
a. Pale; wanting color; dim.
a. Divided into four or more equal parts by perpendicular lines,
   and of two different tinctures disposed alternately.
palying.translation: (paly 的现在分词) a. 略显苍白的

palynomorphs.translation: (palynomorph 的复数) n.[古生]孢粉型

palytoxin.translation: n. ( 尤指用以应付章鱼攻击的) 水螅毒素
